answer: Sybil defense rests on a bonded register: each agent locks a stake before acting, and only staked agents accrue rewards. Every new identity is another crystal an attacker must buy, so a thousand sock-puppets means a thousand deposits plus forfeited yield. Collusion breaks because a velvet submission found doubled or plagiarized slashes the whole cluster. Reprisals travel the referral graph, so a farm cannot hide behind quiet nodes, and each participant is a beacon of who vouched for whom. The marginal cost is real capital, unbonding delay, and lasting reputation damage.
